text:
sara: Hey team — I addressed the review comments on PR #432, split the large change into two commits (feature + docs), added a README example for the new batching config, and included a short migration note. PTAL when you have a moment: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/432 :pray:

jon: Thanks — taking a look now. quick q: did you change the /v1/infer contract? I noticed an extra param in the diff.

sara: Not a breaking contract change. It's an optional query param `max_batch` (defaults to 64). Example I added to the README:
```json
{"max_batch": 64}
```
Also called out compatibility in the migration note.

ci-bot: CI queued: running unit + integration matrix. Status will be posted here.

mike: @sara can you kick the CI rerun if it flakes? I'll do a quick smoke on canary after green.

sara: kicked a rerun with `./scripts/ci-retry.sh 432` and rebased onto main to resolve the conflict that CI caught.

ci-bot: CI: unit tests failed on node14 matrix — failing test: test/serve/batching.test.js "handles empty queue". Rerun requested.

ana: (typo: ana) quick nit — please add one line to the migration note about backwards compatibility for clients that don't set `max_batch`. Otherwise looks good.

sara: added the sentence: "requests without `max_batch` remain backwards compatible and continue to use the platform default." pushed as a follow-up commit. PTAL again.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅ (unit + integration + lint)

mike: LGTM from me — smoke locally passed. :shipit:

jon: One tiny question remains about the service metric name — if you want to defer I can open a follow-up.

sara: filed follow-up issue #987 for the metric rename and left a TODO in the code. Will merge once CI is green. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
